meta.description: The default branch protection configuration must require a pull request, at least one approving review, and passing status checks, and must forbid direct pushes and force-pushes.

assessment.message: At least one approving review is required before merge.

error.message: required_pull_request_reviews is missing, null, or required_approving_review_count is 0.
error.guidance: Require pull request reviews on the default branch with required_approving_review_count >= 1.

assessment.message: At least one required status check is configured.

error.message: required_status_checks is missing, null, or has no contexts.
error.guidance: Require at least one passing status check before merge to the default branch.

assessment.message: Force pushes to the default branch are forbidden.

error.guidance: Disable force pushes on the default branch.

assessment.message: Protection rules are enforced for administrators, so direct pushes cannot bypass them.

error.guidance: Enable enforce_admins so administrators cannot bypass the review/status-check requirements with a direct push.
